notes:
V4.0.3 — hotfix for the Tools slot save crash.

Three bugs in the same code path, all from when I refactored Tools into slot-based saving in V3.2.0:

1. AttributeError: 'core.data' has no attribute 'update_env_keys'. I called the wrong name — the function is write_env_keys. Fixed in ui/overview.py.

2. write_env_keys silently DROPS empty values (by design — 'a blank field should never wipe an existing key'). My 'clear all slots then refill' pattern was broken: clearing was a no-op, so re-pointing a slot to 'Unassigned' didn't actually erase the stale env var. Fixed by adding a new core.data.delete_env_keys(names) helper and calling it before write_env_keys.

3. ENV_KEYS allowlist only contained LONG/SHORT/DAY entries. Custom-bot slot keys (e.g. ALPACA_API_KEY_CRYPTO) were silently dropped by the write_env_keys filter. Loosened to also accept any ALPACA_API_KEY_* / ALPACA_SECRET_KEY_* pattern.

Net effect: assigning a key slot to a custom 'crypto' bot now works end-to-end, and reassigning a slot to 'Unassigned' actually clears the stale key (not just hides it from the UI). The custom slot's value is honored by the bot subprocess via the existing ALPACA_API_KEY_<SIDE> env-var contract.
